text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Autumn Fan Appreciation Festival, the "Holy Hoof Festival"!
It's a day to invite fans and entertain them with various events.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While performances and booths were being put on by various groups, like classes and teams,
as for Believe—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Same-class band, yeahhhhhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alright, it's almost time for the real deal!!
Hey, are you guys ready to blow 'em away!?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
H-Hyaa... it's finally time for the real thing...!!
Ugh, I kind of want to check my fingerings
at least three more times before we hit the stage...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“S-Still... I'll do my best!
If the base isn't solid, nothing else holds together...!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, Believe ended up agreeing
to perform in a band with her classmates."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On guitar, performing with absolute confidence, is the former head of the freestyle racing team, Jungle Pocket—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The caring and attentive Dants Flame
would handle the base. On top of that—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Um, how are things on your end, Cafe-chan?
I asked you to handle the drums... or rather, all the percussion,
but are your preparations—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Boom! Bang!! Ta-daaa!!)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...It seems to be in order.
choice_data_list: （……I wasn't playing anything just now, was I?）
（……I wasn't playing anything just now, right?）

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
They seem... a bit too rowdy, so...
I'll just give them a warning... so they
don't go too wild...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Hey. I haven't been able to say anything
since we were practicing, but...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Cafe, that sound you're making...
Don't tell me it's a g-g-gho—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The mystical Manhattan Cafe's percussion part seems to be going exceptionally well too.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"*Ahem*!!
...Anyway, speaking of practice reminded me."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Where the hell did that lazy science nerd run off to?!
Ugh, as if skipping practice wasn't bad enough, she barely shows her face for the final rehearsal and vanishes again!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, aren't you harsh, honestly.
I was just replenishing my sugar levels a bit.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The rehearsal went smoothly in the first place.
Naturally, I will deliver the exact same performance during the real show.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If the purpose of practice is to increase reproducibility,
what doubt could there be in concluding it is unnecessary
when 100% reproducibility has already been achieved?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Aaargh, shut the hell up with all your babbling!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Damn it, acting like that and yet you match my playing on the very first try...!! You really are something else, you know that...?!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To be honest, listening to the rehearsal, there was something undeniably captivating about Agnes Tachyon's violin playing...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Usually engrossed in suspicious physical enhancement research,
she is a prodigy and the daughter of a distinguished family.
Her depths seem truly bottomless, even in a place like this—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Tachyon's here, so everyone's accounted for.
Let's get started. One, two, three, four!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait, this isn't the stage!
And besides, it's not even our turn yet!!
choice_data_list: (Yep, Light O is being Light O again today...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because she kept rushing the tempo on every instrument she tried, they apparently relegated her to vocals...
Which was likely a wise decision.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I got a message from the Fan Thanksgiving executive committee.
It looks like we're supposed to gather in the wings soon.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I see, so my turn has finally come. Then one, two, three, four!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No.
First, we need to move, Right O-san.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Cat, Ho! Cat, Yo!
Cat, cat, cat, Yeahhhh!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yeeeeeeey!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, Calstone Light O's wildly unique vocal performance whipped the audience into a massive frenzy—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Jungle Pocket's flashy guitar roars,
anchored firmly by Dantsu Flame's solid bassline.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe's percussion drives the excitement furiously,
while Agnes Tachyon's brilliant violin adds vibrant color.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A truly flashy, intense, and daring session...
And in the midst of it all, as for Believe—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Make the reverb a bit deeper—
choice_data_list: (...Handling the PA behind the scenes, huh.)
(...Handling the PA behind the scenes, right?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A PA engineer's job is to balance the sound.
They're the foundation that ensures the music is clearly heard."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The fact that the audience can truly enjoy the performances of such unique individuals
is thanks to her hard work, but—"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Pokke's guitar is way too fire!!
I'm gettin' way too hyped, this is crazyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
And Tachyon playing the violin in a band!
A violin!! Ahh, absolute music to my ears... ♡

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"POKKE—!!" "TACHYON—!!"
"CAFE~~!!" "DANTSU—!!"
"WOOOOOOOO—!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The cheers are meant only for
those brilliant girls standing on the stage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even knowing that's just how it is...
I just can't help it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I suddenly recall a conversation
I had with Calstone Light O after her debut race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as discussed back then, we didn't prioritize results during the Junior Class, focusing purely on training...
Keeping that policy, the season progressed into autumn.
choice_data_list: (But while there are people like us—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon and Jungle Pocket were aiming for the GⅠ Hopeful Stakes,
the race that determines the pinnacle of the Junior Class.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I heard that Calstone Light O is also aiming
for the same GⅠ—the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu Flame has also won two Open races in a row.
Having held onto the position of first favorite since her debut,
great things are expected of her in the future.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In terms of evaluation, if I had to say, Manhattan Cafe,
who has been holding back from racing due to her delicate constitution,
would be in a similar position, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Because we have chosen the
1200m turf as our sole domain.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Said to be the dream of all who are involved in racing,
the "Japanese Derby" is the race that crowns the protagonist of an era.
Its distance is 2,400 meters.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, middle-distance courses, including 2400m races,
are considered the 'Royal Road' and are well-equipped with diverse GⅠ races, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In 1,200m races, the only GⅠ events
are the Takamatsunomiya Kinen in spring
and the Sprinters Stakes in autumn.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Furthermore, because entering the Takamatsunomiya Kinen requires being 'Senior class or above'—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of GⅠ races she can aim for, it would start with the Classic year's autumn
Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...There would only be one single race,
and not until autumn of next year.
choice_data_list: (I knew this would happen, but still...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her classmates keep surging ahead. Racing away into the spotlight of the grandest stages.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, we have few places
where we can showcase the fruits of our work—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, the goal is to do the best job possible,
and Believe neither wants to increase her fans
nor stand at the center of the era, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet, seeing my peers right before my eyes, already given a stage
to showcase the fruits of their efforts and shining brightly—
choice_data_list: (Was this really the right choice? I can't help feeling anxious...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer?
What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Lately—)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (After spending a little bit of time together, I somehow started to realize.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: You really wear everything on your sleeve, don't you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "Believe-chan! Over here, over here. We got lots of leftover food from the stalls~! Let's eat together!"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...No.
I'll go later.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, Believe-chan—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Standing slightly away from the after-party bustle,
dazedly chewing over my impatience...
I was startled when someone suddenly called out to me.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I came to ask about that.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: What's the matter, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...When it came to 'endurance,' there was no way to win.
Giving up, they ended up confessing everything.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today... no, ever since my debut, I've felt
this restlessness. Wondering if this is really okay.
All of those feelings...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite my pathetic confession, Believe simply listened in silence.
And after that—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Then let's talk business.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Talking about the work up to this point.
About everything so far—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: This is about work between you and me.
choice_data_list: All the work up to this point...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Do you have any regrets about that?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Is there anything you feel ashamed of?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Prompted by her quiet question, I look back on everything that led us here.
The days spent with Believe, giving our all just to keep sprinting forward...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Our work up to this point.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Can you not stand tall with pride?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I don't think so.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her gaze is unwavering.
Just as it has always been.
Just as it has been this entire time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That's why—
choice_data_list: ...Yeah, you're right. That can't... be true, right?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I accepted it without any resistance.
The feeling settled right into my heart in no time at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"What reason is there to rush?
What reason is there to fear?"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
—Yes.
So, from here on, all I have to do is stay focused.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
To my job.
—To our job.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The bonfire crackles in the distance.
Yet it is no longer blinding.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My mind was completely clear, with only one thought remaining.
—Starting tomorrow, what kind of basic training
should I tackle alongside her next?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...That was all.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Incredible.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Believe-chan sure is amazing...
